title: My game anoun's core mechanic uses an LLM and couldn't exist without it
author: pisv93
selftext:
[anoun](https://anoun.online/) is a deduction game where you guess a hidden noun. With every wrong guess, you learn something your guess has in common with the hidden noun so you can pin down the answer.

  
It does this using an LLM, and a bunch more AI-powered systems around it, for example to prevent giving a clue that is too semantically similar to a previous one.

  
This game would literally never be able to exist without AI. I would have had to spend hundreds upon hundreds of hours manually associating words with properties, and even then it wouldn't be as rich or interesting. Not to mention the development time of the app itself. It just wouldn't have been feasible.

I am so very happy that reasoning language models came into existence, that they helped me give birth to this idea and turn it into reality over the last year.

I have had a few thousand players at this point and many of them love it. So do I, and I hope you will too. :)

Play at [https://anoun.online/](https://anoun.online/)
